title: Current Source Editor baseline
summary: The accepted delivery baseline remains oorexx_source_editor_v0.1-dev5, SHA-256 7b72bdf6195d6b752c92ffe0831888b834de2323fa0a887bf8dfddc45191a440, qualified under ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196. Git now contains a dev6 candidate that replaces direct live-file writes with oorexx.atomic-file/0.1 dev1 publication: generation check first, optional backup publication through AtomicFile, then live candidate publication through AtomicFile with FULL durability requested. Independent r13196 qualification is pending under Rasen Falcon request REQ-00000589; do not promote dev6 until that evidence returns.
invariants: Implementation remains native ooRexx; do not move semantic ownership into Python.
Literal find stays literal; regex grep uses ooRexx RegularExpression semantics.
Recursive file traversal uses ooRexx/RexxUtil facilities rather than an external find subprocess.
Source results retain original path/line/column and enclosing-symbol provenance where available.
User-visible completion order is deterministic and must not depend on Directory iteration order.
Dev6 Atomic File candidate must not be called qualified until the independent r13196/native-provider run passes.
